_README: Join-list + link map for insert-affiliates.mjs. WORKFLOW: (1) sign up for a tool's program at its 'signup' URL, (2) paste YOUR affiliate link into that tool's 'url', (3) run `node insert-affiliates.mjs --apply`. A tool only gets linked when its 'url' is non-empty, so nothing publishes until you've actually joined. 'program': open = self-serve, join today | apply = real program but gated/undisclosed terms, apply to learn | none = no program, will never be linked. 'mentions' = first-mention count across the 97 articles (from the 2026-07-03 dry run). 'match' = text aliases (longest matched first).
